name: DOOM Eternal
native_kbm_note: The PS5/PS4 version has no native keyboard/mouse gameplay support. It is not on Push Square's list of PS5/PS4 games with mouse and keyboard support (pushsquare.com/guides/all-ps5-ps4-games-with-mouse-and-keyboard-support).
notes: There is no sprint (you always run). PC weapon keys 1-8 and mouse wheel next/previous have no direct PS5 equivalent: on PS5 you tap R1 to swap to the last weapon or hold R1 for the weapon wheel (pick with the right stick), so only Q is mapped. Dossier on Touchpad is inferred from the standard id layout (Xbox View = Dossier); no source lists it explicitly. Mission info (LALT) and push-to-talk (B) are omitted.
